summary: g=p*rho/(1-p+p*rho) correctly divides an unchanged all-population total using relative geographic yield. Approximately $13 million per ten CA QALYs is an inspectable subjective partial-naloxone scenario, not a measured or statistical expected return.

arithmetic.method: Independently recalculated every scenario multiplier and price; zero scenarios have no finite positive price. Compared five existing scenario Qall values to accepted USA registry: exact equality for all five. New CA-only sensitivities retain central Qall.
arithmetic.nationalClinicalModel: No re-audit or change to underlying clinical assumptions. CA allocation uses all-population QALYs, not USA-edition QALYs already multiplied by USA geography. Do not add CA return to USA return: nested geographies are not additive.

requiredClarifications.edit: Define p as a pre-yield share of marginal at-risk exposure/person-time geographically in California, with location/mobility handled there once. Define rho as CA/non-CA incremental health yield per that exposure, after relative differences in existing rescue/targeting. Remove wording that both p and rho absorb the same patient-location and alternative-rescue judgments unless a conditional factorization is specified.
requiredClarifications.reason: Current wording assigns patient location, later mobility and alternatives to both terms, leaving possible duplicate adjustments. No numeric change is necessary if .15/.75 are explicitly interpreted as these distinct conditional judgments.

requiredClarifications.edit: State that normalization holds the nationwide mean clinical yield fixed: the implied elsewhere yield is proportional to 1/(1-p+p*rho), and CA yield to rho/(1-p+p*rho). This is allocation calibration, not a separately demonstrated loss of total clinical benefit.
requiredClarifications.reason: Lower rho reallocates benefit outside CA. It does not reduce Qall. If future evidence changes actual population mix/average yield, recompute national model rather than relying on fixed-total allocation.

requiredClarifications.edit: Keep visible 'subjective CA allocation; naloxone mortality pathway only; full recipient cost' and round central to about $13 million. Preserve Sold out caveat and zero-CA scenario.
requiredClarifications.reason: Neither p=.15 nor rho=.75 is source-identified, and other portfolio benefits are unestimated.
